description: This file defines types and functions related to system run approval context, including parsing payloads, resolving request and runtime contexts, and normalizing command data.

methods.name: normalizeCommandText
methods.description: Normalizes input to a string, returning an empty string if input is not a string.

methods.name: normalizeCommandPreview
methods.description: Returns null if the preview is non-empty and different from the authoritative command; otherwise returns null.
